586-678-2292.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

359-813-2320.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Acrobatic Maneuver.
359-813-2320.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and drawing a card, and putting Acrobatic Maneuver into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Acrobatic Maneuver to your hand.
Repeat.

1580-4063-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4063-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Fleshtaker and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

116-512-1355.easyPrerequisites: Sanctum Weaver and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-1355.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two enchantments.
116-512-1355.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Sanctum Weaver, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-1355.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Sanctum Weaver's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

3554-4872-7164.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Solve the Equation by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Solve the Equation and Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3249-5457--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-5457--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Selvala triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4050-4559-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
4050-4559-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

333-2034-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2034-7424.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Repeat.

661-3685-4659-5705.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Glaring Fleshraker. 
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Sculpting Steel. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3698-3764-7363.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
When the Mutagen enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Mutagen.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

2842-5170-5256-6132.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

57-283-4846-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4846-5295.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2146-3532-5078-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2511-2932-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2511-2932-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2511-2932-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

3484-5391-5902-6753.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
You have at least three energy counters.
3484-5391-5902-6753.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1029-1376-5028.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
1029-1376-5028.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Priest of Titania.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-1376-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

428-1694-1817-2770.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
428-1694-1817-2770.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a copy of the Ghyrson Starn spell that isn't legendary.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn spells.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 7.

3284-4550-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3284-4550-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

2724-3194-3582-5147.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

628-2122-4050-4772.notablePrerequisites: Mindless Automaton has an even number of +1/+1 counters on it.
628-2122-4050-4772.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat step 1 until Mindless Automaton has zero +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mindless Automaton, adding one mana of any color.
Mindless Automaton dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a total of six +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1247-2033-3099.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-2033-3099.description:
Activate Pili-Pala using Paradise Mantle's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {G} and one mana of any one color.
Repeat.
